activity.title: Excited to share we won 3rd out of 1.2k applicants and closed a $5k cash prize in 24 hours at the Inference-Time Compute Hackathon, hosted by Mercor , Anthropic , Etched , Cognition , Prime Intellect . My teammates Joseph Liu , Bowen Cheng , Jenny Zhou , and I worked nonstop for 24 hours to take Human Gym from an idea to a delivered, working product. Human Gym is an AI coach for physical work that fine-tunes NVIDIA’s Cosmos 3 world model with annotated egocentric data to understand real-world tasks and turn human demonstrations into higher-quality training data for robotics data collection. We fine-tuned and deployed using Prime Intellect and built a full stack product from model inference and training to user experience. As Mercor scales beyond $2B in annualized revenue, robotics is a market it cares deeply about. This post is a bit overdue. Getting a degree means nothing unless you use it to make a positive impact. I'm excited to share that I recently graduated from Northwestern University with a Master's degree in Public Policy & Administration. I have a very crazy story from training to become a monk to ending up like this. I'm honored Northwestern University wrote about my story here - https://lnkd.in/eyHf53f7 . I want to thank Sara Kuehlhorn Friedman and Mollie F. for being such great teachers who actually care about students! I also want to thank Matthew Khoriaty , Bowen Cheng , Ethan Zhang , Olivia Mofus , and Sripad Ganti for being good friends during my time there.

Congrats to Ian Chang on finishing a great summer internship. It’s been genuinely rewarding watching you grow and learn these past few months. It has me reflecting on my own journey from an intern two summers ago to being on the other side as an intern mentor the past two summers. There’s nothing like seeing someone grow from the same nervousness and tentative questions I had during my experience to being confident in the project that they’ve owned start to finish. If there’s anything I would encourage all of our interns to take away from their experience is to keep connecting your technical skills back to real business problems. As AI makes coding cheaper and faster, it won’t be about who can deliver the fastest, it will be about who understands the problem deep enough to know what’s worth building in the first place. Congrats again Ian on a great summer. Excited to see where you take it from here!

Excited to share we won 3rd out of 1.2k applicants and closed a $5k cash prize in 24 hours at the Inference-Time Compute Hackathon, hosted by Mercor , Anthropic , Etched , Cognition , Prime Intellect . My teammates Joseph Liu , Bowen Cheng , Jenny Zhou , and I worked nonstop for 24 hours to take Human Gym from an idea to a delivered, working product. Human Gym is an AI coach for physical work that fine-tunes NVIDIA’s Cosmos 3 world model with annotated egocentric data to understand real-world tasks and turn human demonstrations into higher-quality training data for robotics data collection. We fine-tuned and deployed using Prime Intellect and built a full stack product from model inference and training to user experience. As Mercor scales beyond $2B in annualized revenue, robotics is a market it cares deeply about. We’re excited to win the Mercor Applied AI Track and contribute to VLM intelligence and data infrastructure that will help humans train the next generation of robots. Grateful to all the young and hungry people I met! dhruv ahuja , Kaodi Dike , Vincent Qi , Merdy Udatha , Siddarth Kolla , Jonathan Ouyang , Aashrith Bandaru , Ashwanth Thiyagarajan , Kristen O'Donnell and more.
